prompt:
A wide picture for a 2D game, piece keeper-damage. Six panels of one hanging clockwork mechanism of a metal owl, shown on six sprites in a row from intact to broken: all seven parts, then fewer, then half, then none, then a break with shards flying, then a stunned wobble. Dark iron and bronze. The subject is drawn alone on a plain aged cream paper ground with visible paper grain and fibre, in dark muted ink with etched crosshatch shading and near-black outlines, no green, no text.  Style: a dark painterly etched storybook illustration, ink and wash with fine etched cross-hatching and a faint paper grain inside the shapes only. Large shapes have a clean near-black ink outline #171614 about 2 px wide at this size. One light source sits in front and slightly above: upper edges brighter, lower edges shaded with fine hatching. Palette: charcoal and ash-blue darks, muted sepia, bone ivory #FFF5DC, warm gold #E9C46A, bronze #94611E, with only tiny accents of crimson #FF3658. Seed variation 2: a fresh composition. 

Style (required): dark, muted ink on aged paper, like an etched storybook engraving. Etched ink linework with near-black ink outlines; crosshatch and fine line hatching for every shadow and form; visible aged paper grain and fibre texture under all colour; hand-printed, slightly uneven ink. No flat fills, no vector shapes, no smooth digital gradients, no glossy 3D rendering.
